question: What becomes of those who enter the white, black, and red after hearing?
premises: At the end of hearing, some from this entered white, black, and red.
Then in fire, all mantras were satisfied.
inference: Those who enter the three colors after hearing and satisfy all mantras in fire are reduced to consciousness-space only.
uncertainties: The exact referents of the three colors are unclear.
Whether "entered" denotes initiation or another transition is unclear.
Whether "fire" is literal, ritual, or symbolic is unclear.
plain_english: At the end of hearing, some from this entered the white, black, and red; then in fire, having satisfied all mantras, they became consciousness-space only.
